traits.name: Sailing
traits.text: compendium/skills.md#Lore check, the navigator plots an optimal course. The severity of environmental conditions other than temperature are reduced by one step for 24 hours (two steps on a critical success). This changes moderate damage to minor damage, winds that create greater difficult terrain cause only difficult terrain, and so on.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: dagger, scroll case with ship's charts, writing set;

traits.name: Navigator's Edge
traits.text: The navigator deals an additional 1d6 (1d6) weapon damage when on a ship.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +8 (agile, finesse, versatile s); Damage 1d4+4 (1d4+4) piercing plus navigator's edge

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ dagger +8 (agile, thrown 10 feet, versatile s); Damage 1d4+4 (1d4+4) piercing plus navigator's edge
